title: Oozing Uruguayan Plant-based Empanadas
description: A vegetarian twist on the traditional Uruguayan empanada, featuring ancho chillies and a caramelized filling that's sure to cure even the worst hangover.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, grind the ancho chillies into a fine powder.
In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic until the onion is caramelized.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, chili powder, and salt. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the black beans and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the filling in the center of each dough circle and fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Seal the edges by pressing the dough together with a fork.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with oil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
If using cheese, sprinkle on top of the empanadas during the last 5 minutes of baking.
